description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R scores, expressed as percentages, for different language models and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) configurations. The horizontal axis represents the model type, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-13B” and “LLaMA-2-70B”, presented in no particular order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the score values, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 90, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each model type, there are four bars representing different SFT configurations: “no SFT” (light orange), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light pink), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink). For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 65%, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 71%, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 79%, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 84%. For LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 70%, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 82%, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 85%, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 88%. The bars are grouped by model type, with each group containing the four SFT configurations stacked side-by-side. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
